# Azərbaycan Kardiologiya Cəmiyyəti

> Professional organization for cardiologists in Azerbaijan providing clinical guidelines, conferences, educational resources, and member services for cardiovascular medicine.

The Azerbaijan Society of Cardiology is the primary professional body representing cardiologists and cardiovascular specialists in Azerbaijan. The site serves as a hub for clinical education, conference organization, and dissemination of evidence-based cardiology guidelines and research.

## Key Topics

- Cardiology Society
- Cardiovascular Disease
- Clinical Guidelines
- Cardiology Conferences
- Invasive Cardiology
- Heart Failure
- Medical Events
- Professional Development
- Azerbaijan Health
- ESC Guidelines
- Preventive Cardiology
- Hypertension Management
- Lipid Therapy
- Stroke Prevention
- Women's Cardiovascular Health

## Core Organization

- [Homepage](https://akc.az): Homepage of Azerbaijan Society of Cardiology professional organization
- [English Homepage](https://akc.az/en): English homepage of Azerbaijan Society of Cardiology
- [About Us](https://akc.az/haqqimizda): About page describing Azerbaijan Cardiology Society organization
- [Member Sign In](https://akc.az/sign-in): Login portal for Azerbaijan Cardiology Society member accounts
- [Member Registration](https://akc.az/customer-request): Member and doctor registration form for cardiology society

## Conferences & Events

- [Events Calendar](https://akc.az/tedbirler): Calendar of cardiology events and medical conferences in Azerbaijan
- [XI National Cardiology Congress](https://akc.az/tedbirler/akc-xi-milli-konqresi): XI National Cardiology Congress event details and registration
- [Kardiofest 2024](https://akc.az/tedbirler/kardiofest-2024): Kardiofest 2024 cardiology congress on invasive and pulmonary topics
- [Invasive Cardiology Meeting](https://akc.az/tedbirler/invaziv-toplanti): Invasive cardiology meeting on bifurcation lesions and heart failure
- [Lankaran Regional Conference](https://akc.az/tedbirler/lenkeran-regional-konfransi): Lankaran regional cardiology conference event and registration details
- [Lankaran 2022 Conference](https://akc.az/tedbirler/lenkeran-konfransi-2022): Lankaran 2022 cardiology conference event details and information

## Clinical Guidelines & Reference

- [National Guidelines & Recommendations](https://akc.az/rehber-tovsiyeleri-milli-tovsiyyeler): National cardiology guidelines and clinical recommendations
- [Cardiology Journals & Publications](https://akc.az/jurnallar): Cardiology journals, publications, and guidelines archive

## Educational Resources

- [Medical Presentations](https://akc.az/fealiyyetimiz-prezentasiyalar): Medical presentations on hypertension, lipid therapy, and stroke prevention
- [Cardiology Bulletins](https://akc.az/fealiyyetimiz-bulleten): Cardiology bulletins and medical publications on cardiovascular topics

## Optional

- [Activity Plan](https://akc.az/fealiyyetimiz-fealiyyet-plani): Annual activity plan and organizational documents
